opening: Lord, meet us gently today and always
body: Lord, today my heart may contain stones, thorns, and patches of hard ground. But I place all of it into Your hands. Be the Gardener who tills what I cannot, removes what I cling to, and waters what has begun to grow. Let my heart become rich soil—not because I am strong, but because You never stop cultivating me. Keep me close to You, and let whatever fruit comes from my life bring glory to You alone. Amen.
